name: form-grid
title: Form grid
description: A form layout on a 12-column grid: fields span columns, wrap predictably and stack at 320px with their hints aligned.
docs: FormGrid is a grid of columns (12 by default) and FormGrid.Item puts one field in it. span is the number of columns, as a number or as an object per width ({ base: 12, sm: 6, lg: 4 }); a plain number applies from the sm width up and below it the field takes the whole row, so a form stacks on a narrow screen by itself. start leaves room in front of an item, and fullWidth takes the whole row at every width. The widths are those of the grid itself, not of the window (sm from 28rem, md from 36rem, lg from 48rem), so the same form behaves the same in a page, a dialog and a sheet. Items align to the top, so a hint or an error under one field never pushes its neighbour out of line, and the DOM order is the reading order at every width. as="fieldset" with a legend groups the fields, and disabled switches them all off together. gap is sm, md or lg.
